topic: Whole-operation DXF write allocation rollback and retry
purpose: Sweep one-shot allocation failures across public dxfRW::write, including setup, LINE/LWPOLYLINE/CIRCLE/IMAGE/MESH/SPLINE/HATCH entity emission, OBJECTS emission, finalization, generated NOD/GROUP, ACAD_IMAGE_DICT/IMAGEDEF, nested named DICTIONARY/XRECORD/DATALINK dependencies, and output publication.

generatedObjectGraph.groupOutputHandle: remapped and verified through dictionary edge
generatedObjectGraph.memberOutputHandle: remapped LINE handle verified in GROUP membership
generatedObjectGraph.memberOutputHandles: Both remapped LINE and CIRCLE handles verified in GROUP membership
generatedObjectGraph.imageDefinitionOutputHandle: remapped and verified through IMAGE and ACAD_IMAGE_DICT readback
generatedObjectGraph.imageDictionaryPath: NOD[ACAD_IMAGE_DICT] -> IMAGE dictionary -> IMAGEDEF -> IMAGE reference
generatedObjectGraph.namedDictionaryOutputHandle: remapped and verified through root entry
generatedObjectGraph.nestedDictionaryPath: NOD[WHOLE_OPERATION_CUSTOM] -> named DICTIONARY -> XRECORD and three DATALINK records

implementation.productionBehavior: EntityRecordScope now latches writer-local staged-record errors into the enclosing dxfRW operation before record abort restores the local writer error bit. DxfWriterRecordScope also converts commit/materialization exceptions into sticky writer failure. This prevents a failed variable-length entity record from being silently omitted while the document publishes.
details: Generated MESH output now participates in the whole-operation sweep, including faces, edges, crease values and property overrides.
Generated SPLINE output now participates in the whole-operation sweep with a degree-1 control-point/knot profile and exact typed readback.
Generated patterned HATCH output now participates in the whole-operation sweep with a closed polyline boundary, pattern dash vector and seed point.

procedure.validation: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction_tests -j 4; ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R ^libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction$ --output-on-failure; build-gcc/tests/libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction_tests /private/tmp/libdxfrw-mesh-whole-operation-control; cmake --build build-asan-custom --target libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction_tests -j 4; ctest --test-dir build-asan-custom -R ^libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction$ --output-on-failure
procedure.allocationScope: Global operator-new fault injection is armed only during dxfRW::write. One-time writer/codec setup allocations are warmed before calibrating each encoding. Each failure is one-shot so diagnostic handling and same-codec retry run normally.

result.ctest: Normal 1/1 passed in 1.30 seconds; ASan 1/1 passed in 8.46 seconds.

failureFoundAndFixed.symptom: Injected allocation failure set the staged writer error, but record-scope cleanup restored its prior clear bit; the whole DXF write returned success with the LWPOLYLINE omitted.
failureFoundAndFixed.fix: When EntityRecordScope sees a writer-local failure, it now sets dxfRW::m_writeError before DxfWriterRecordScope cleanup restores the writer’s prior local error bit. The record-scope commit path also latches exceptions during byte materialization or inspection.
failureFoundAndFixed.regression: The new whole-operation allocation sweep reaches this case and requires atomic refusal, unchanged destination/caller state, successful same-codec retry, and complete readback.

currentRun.normalDirectRun: ASCII 242 allocation offsets; Binary 238 allocation offsets; both pass rollback, caller-state preservation, same-codec retry, byte comparison and typed readback.
currentRun.generatedMeshReadback: One triangle, three edge pairs, one crease value, and one property override with two types matched after ASCII and Binary readback.
currentRun.generatedSplineReadback: Degree-1 SPLINE with two 3D control points and four knots matched after ASCII and Binary readback.
currentRun.generatedHatchReadback: Patterned ANSI31 HATCH with a closed four-vertex polyline boundary, one pattern line containing three dash values, and one seed point matched after ASCII and Binary readback.

limits: This generated transaction control exercises LINE, variable-length LWPOLYLINE, CIRCLE, IMAGE, MESH vertices/faces/edges/creases/property overrides, degree-1 SPLINE control points/knots, patterned HATCH boundary/pattern/seed data, IMAGEDEF, raw XRECORD, three DATALINK records with two custom target references, and rooted NOD/GROUP, ACAD_IMAGE_DICT, and named-DICTIONARY graphs; it is not exhaustive coverage of every whole-drawing allocation path, record family, platform, or filesystem failure mode.
Same-library typed readback and byte-identical retry establish transaction behavior only, not independent interoperability or format-support claims.
No DWG or DXF fixture file is committed. Generated output is created in the test scratch directory and removed after each encoding.
